browser_origin.title: Address in the browser
browser_origin.fix: Open Inkadra from the address set in PUBLIC_URL, or fix PUBLIC_URL.

websocket.title: Real-time collaboration (WebSocket)
websocket.fix: The proxy must forward WebSocket requests on /collab, with the Upgrade and Connection headers.

public_url_https.title: PUBLIC_URL uses HTTPS
public_url_https.fix: Outside localhost use an https:// address: sign-in cookies are only secure over HTTPS.

public_url_matches_request.title: The server sees the public address
public_url_matches_request.fix: The proxy must send X-Forwarded-Proto and Host, and TRUST_PROXY must include the proxy’s address.

proxy_trusted.title: Proxy trusted
proxy_trusted.fix: Add the address the proxy connects from (the peer address) to TRUST_PROXY.

database.title: Database
database.fix: Check DATABASE_URL and that Postgres is running.

queue.title: Job queue (Valkey)
queue.fix: Check REDIS_URL and that Valkey is running.

data_dir_writable.title: Data folder writable
data_dir_writable.fix: DATA_DIR must be writable by the container user (uid 1000).

storage.title: File storage
storage.fix: Check the storage settings: local folder or S3 bucket, credentials and permissions.

versions.description: Automatic versions are kept for 30 days. Named versions stay until you delete them.
versions.name: Version name
versions.restoreBody: The current state is saved as a version first, then the board returns to this version for every collaborator. Offline edits inside note text, checklists and drawings that the version replaces will be lost. Comments and reviews do not change, and elements on the board now keep their guest visibility.
versions.deleteBody: The saved version will be deleted. The current board stays unchanged.
versions.restoredGeneric: The board was restored to a saved version.

admin.registrationHelp: Closed blocks every new account, including invitations. Existing accounts and guest links keep working.
admin.storageHelp: Original uploads across the instance. Derived previews and physical storage capacity are not included.
admin.providersHelp: Read-only installation configuration. Change providers and SMTP in the server configuration.
admin.forbidden: Only instance administrators can access this section.
admin.teamHelp: Global administrators manage the instance. Members keep their individual project and board permissions.
admin.lastAdmin: Keep at least one active administrator.
admin.activityHelp: Last activity uses recorded session updates and token use. Projects counts direct memberships, including archived projects; board-only access is excluded.
admin.inviteHelp: Invitations create members, never administrators. Promote a named account after it joins.
admin.shareInvite: Email was not sent. Share this invitation privately.
admin.deactivateHelp: Deactivate {{name}}? Sessions and personal tokens will be revoked. Content and project memberships are preserved.
admin.conflict: This change conflicts with the current state. Keep at least one active administrator; existing accounts do not need an invitation.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Elements found in snapshots from the last 30 days and absent from the current board. Changes between snapshots may not be recoverable. Dates show the last available snapshot, not deletion time. Restore containers first to keep their children’s placement.
trash.empty: No recoverable elements in the available snapshots.
trash.error: Could not complete recovery. The list may be partial: try again.
trash.restored: Element restored. You can undo this action.
trash.boardLinkOnly: Restoring a board card recovers its link only, not a deleted sub-board.
